column4: Effect Resistance substats are increasingly used for effects like CC or Buff Duration Reduction/Buff Removal to be resisted. This is especially thanks to Karl Heron's passive Effect Resistance Boost which raises the possibility of this considerably.
column15: O'Mok's powerful Guardian Spirit effect has given the Magic team a fighting chance by preserving their survivability (DMG Immunity) and extending their skill use efficiency (CC Immunity). It may be slightly shaky at the moment with the Attack Team becoming even stronger.
column26: Well lasting in the meta for months, thanks to high but resistant investment. Players only need to aim for Defensive Substats rather than being torn between SPD VS Offensive DMG substats. Powerful Tank teams go all in on Block, DMG Taken Reduction, HP% substats despite not using the Gatekeeper set.
